packageRules.description: The Kubernetes libraries and controller-runtime move as a set: controller-runtime pins the k8s.io minor it was built against, and the Makefile derives the envtest control-plane version from k8s.io/api. Upgrading one alone gives a build that compiles against one version and tests against another.

fiber stays on v2 until qubership-core-lib-go-fiber-server-utils publishes its /v3 module. The management server is built by that library: fiberserver.New takes a fiber v2 Config and its builder returns a fiber v2 App, so the service cannot move to fiber v3 alone. Remove this rule in the change that moves the library and fiber to v3 together.
